verdict.rationale: Mercury's own materials cover all three pillars of the story in one product. Banking includes checking, savings and Treasury (mercury-docs-39, mercury-docs-26), with ACH, check and wire payouts (mercury-docs-53). Spend management comes through cards, limits, reimbursements and approvals 'all in one place' (mercury-docs-38, mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-2). Bill pay is AI-assisted bill reading and payment (mercury-docs-3), and invoicing, receipt matching and accounting sync round out the platform (mercury-docs-4, mercury-docs-5, mercury-docs-6). A 5-year customer independently confirms heavy use of virtual cards with limits and multiple purpose-named accounts on the single platform (mercury-comm-1). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the bill pay workflow beyond one marketing line, and independent corroboration that founders actually replaced separate spend and bill-pay tools with Mercury.
